aggregation.ci_parity_count: count of instances i with L[c,i]/U[s0,i] <= 1 <= U[c,i]/L[s0,i]; all bounds positive; descriptive only, never changes a selection
aggregation.comparison: cross multiplication of reduced integer pairs; no float and no formatted ratio feeds a decision

envelope.L: L[c,i] = min over blocks of lower[c,i,b]
envelope.U: U[c,i] = max over blocks of upper[c,i,b]

aggregation.not_pooled: intervals, envelopes and ranges are not pooled confidence intervals
aggregation.pair_median: m[c,i] = exact median over the 2N process medians of (c,i); an even count takes the exact arithmetic mean of the two middle decimals
aggregation.process_value: median.point_estimate of the (candidate, instance, block) process
aggregation.ratio: r[c,i] = m[c,i] / m[s0,i], stored as a reduced [numerator, denominator] decimal-integer pair
aggregation.score: score[c] = exact median over the nine r[c,i]
aggregation.wins_vs_simplest: exact count of instances with r[c,i] < 1 (strict, by cross multiplication)

criterion.batching: comparable groups: iter_batched(setup, routine, BatchSize::PerIteration); never iter or iter_batched_ref
criterion.saved_baseline: none requested; children start from an empty output directory

bench_profile.note: byte-identical explicit [profile.bench] in both repositories; cargo ignores an explicit panic setting for the bench profile and always unwinds

environment.zincplus_bench_command: cargo bench --locked --offline --profile bench --color never -p zinc-protocol --bench poseidon -vv

epoch.id: tuning_epoch_id = SHA-256 of the exact bundle bytes
epoch.rule: every contributing group is swept from one source SHA/lockfile before any default changes; the generated defaults module is the only permitted source diff

failure: any failing or mismatching (candidate, instance) preflight or any child failure produces failure.json with the complete matrix and exact error, no sweep-metadata.json, no child tree and no tuning result; a complete sweep never excludes a candidate

gates.profile: dev (the default cargo test profile): the gates are correctness tests, not measurements; a release-profile build would only duplicate the fat-LTO evidence build in every role target
gates.required_output_prefix: test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored

name: TUNE-1
preflight_matrix_attempt: one bench attempt (form 2, mode sweep) evaluates every (candidate, instance) pair and writes sweep-metadata.json

contents: exact aggregate ratios and interval envelopes
sorted (path,size,sha256) list of every consumed estimates.json
result.encoding: UTF-8, sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace, one trailing LF
result.id: tuning_id = SHA-256 of the exact tuning-result.json bytes

schedule.child_ordinal: two-digit zero-based position inside the block
schedule.first_half: block b in 0..N-1 executes the canonical order rotated left by b
schedule.position_balance: each candidate occupies every within-block candidate position exactly twice across the 2N blocks
schedule.process_granularity: one fresh benchmark process per (candidate, instance) configuration inside a block, because one process holds exactly one environment configuration; a block is therefore 9*N fresh processes
schedule.second_half: block b in N..2N-1 executes the reversed canonical order rotated left by b-N
schedule.within_block: for instance in 1..=9 (ascending): for candidate in the block order

cases.condition: s0 not in band and wins_vs_simplest[p] >= 7
cases.label: performance

selection.simplest: s0 = the first candidate in simplicity order

single_candidate_epoch.decision: 2026-09-10: every group schedules exactly one candidate (Zinc: square, the winner of the two-candidate qz sweeps of commit 3b2256d; limber: its persisted v9 default k = 9), so a TUNE-1 sweep is 18 children (N = 1, selection case only_admissible) and still yields an eligible epoch with origin archives

statistic.parsing: exact decimal; JSON number tokens become rationals
statistic.transcript_policy: each candidate/instance pair has one fixed transcript; Criterion repeats do not resample it

limber.admissibility: deterministic-coins double construction with identical commitments, every canonical serialized proof component, structured analytical remainder and P0-D bounded primality audit; shape satisfiability and canonical public IO

benchmark_coins.candidate_index: zero-based position in the pinned candidate order

zincplus.admissibility: Checked/Unchecked shadow parity preflight per (candidate, instance): identical digests, commitment roots, sampled moduli/audits and complete proof wire bytes
zincplus.benchmark_coins_note: no external prover coins on the Zinc+ path

tuning_corpus.gate: both repositories rederive every instance and require this SHA-256
tuning_corpus.message_framing: m_j = first 32 bytes of BLAKE3("limber-poseidon2-v1/msg/inst" || k_be4 || j_be4) big-endian masked to the low 250 bits, j = 1..=H

zincplus_admissibility: complete Checked/Unchecked parity preflight: identical digests, commitment roots, sampled moduli and audits, complete wire bytes, and the literal non-native predicate (every sampled host/PCS modulus differs from all three width-extended target moduli; a collision rejects after sampling and never resamples)
